style: Storybook illustration from a luxurious classic Japanese children's picture book. Hand-painted watercolor and gouache on cream textured paper, delicate sepia ink linework, soft visible brush strokes, paper grain, gentle warm light, rich red and amber autumn palette, elegant, magical, cozy. Vertical composition, the upper third is calm open sky. No text, no letters, no people

items.name: hiru
items.prompt: An old Kyoto temple on a steep forested hillside in late autumn daytime: high on the hill a small vermilion tahoto pagoda with exactly two roofs and a round white dome-shaped middle between the two roofs and a thin bronze spire, peeking out above a sea of red and orange maple trees, below it long curved grey-tiled temple halls and a covered wooden staircase corridor climbing the slope, a winding stone path in the foreground, pale blue sky with soft clouds

items.name: aki
items.prompt: A quiet temple pond in Kyoto framed by blazing red, orange and golden maple trees, a small arched stone bridge across the water, far up on the hill above the treetops a small vermilion pagoda with only two roofs, red maple leaves floating on the still water, warm late afternoon sunlight

items.name: yoru
items.prompt: Night illumination at a Kyoto temple garden: red and orange maple trees lit warmly from below glow against a deep indigo starry sky and are mirrored perfectly in a still dark pond, high on the dark hillside a softly lit small vermilion pagoda with only two roofs, small stone lanterns with golden light along the shore
